question: How should the breath be drawn in at the root of tongue and palate?
premises: Attention is placed at the root of tongue and palate
The breath is the object of the practice
The breath should be drawn in slowly
inference: One should place awareness at the root of the tongue and palate and slowly drink in the breath.
plain_english: Placing awareness at the root of the tongue and palate, one should slowly drink in the breath.
